papers.title: Allosteric inhibition rescues hydrocephalus caused by catalytically inactive Shp2 in mice
papers.abstract: SHP2, a protein tyrosine phosphatase (PTP) crucial in Ras-MAPK signaling, is associated with various human congenital diseases and cancers. Here, we show that the catalytically inactive Shp2 C459S mutation results in communicating hydrocephalus, similar to the catalytically activating Shp2 E76K and Mek1 DD mutants. Unlike previous mutants, however, Shp2 C459S/+ mutation uniquely affects ciliary development rather than neurogenesis, leading to structural abnormalities in cilia and impaired ciliary motility. Differential scanning fluorimetry suggested that SHP2 C459S , SHP2 E76K , and SHP2 C459S/E76K mutations all induce an open SHP2 conformation, but only SHP2 C459S leads to aberrant GAB1 phosphorylation in cells expressing wild-type SHP2. Consistent with this distinct signaling profile, brain ventricular tissues from Shp2 C459S/+ mice exhibit elevated GAB1 and AKT phosphorylation despite normal ERK and STAT3 activities, implicating dysregulated PI3K–AKT signaling in the pathogenesis of hydrocephalus. Importantly, pharmacological inhibition of PI3K markedly rescues ciliogenesis defects and alleviates hydrocephalus in mutant mice. Furthermore, the allosteric SHP2 inhibitor SHP099 increases the thermal stability of SHP2C459S protein, consistent with a shift toward a closed state, and ameliorates hydrocephalus in Shp2 C459S/+ mice. These findings suggest that, in this engineered mouse model, Shp2 -associated hydrocephalus is driven by conformational changes rather than altered catalytic activity. Our results underscore the therapeutic potential of conformation-specific allosteric inhibitors in targeting both catalytically active and inactive SHP2 mutants.
papers.titleZh: 別構抑制挽救 Shp2 催化失活小鼠水腦症
papers.summaryZh: 研究顯示催化失活的 Shp2 C459S 突變在小鼠中導致交通性水腦症，其表現類似催化活化的 Shp2 E76K 與 Mek1 DD 突變體。與先前突變不同，Shp2 C459S/+ 主要影響纖毛發育而非神經發生，造成纖毛結構異常與運動受損。作者發現腦室組織中 GAB1 與 AKT 磷酸化升高，但 ERK 與 STAT3 活性正常，提示 PI3K–AKT 訊號失調參與致病。藥理學抑制 PI3K 可顯著改善纖毛生成缺陷並減輕水腦症，而別構性 SHP2 抑制劑 SHP099 提高 SHP2C459S 熱穩定性並改善 Shp2 C459S/+ 小鼠的水腦症，顯示此模型的水腦症由構形改變而非催化活性改變驅動。

papers.title: Endogenous cAMP production within tissue fibroblasts is required for spontaneous fibrosis resolution
papers.abstract: Pathologic myofibroblasts (MFs) are pivotal effector cells in the development of persistent tissue fibrosis following parenchymal injury, and their activation and accumulation has been linked to a failure to phenotypically dedifferentiate and thus to resist apoptosis. The second messenger cyclic AMP (cAMP) has been shown to induce MF dedifferentiation and restore their sensitivity to apoptosis in vitro, but its endogenous role within MFs during fibrosis resolution in vivo has not been explored. To test the hypothesis that cAMP generation and signaling within fibroblasts is essential for fibrosis resolution, we leveraged the spontaneously resolving nature of the single-dose intrapulmonary and subcutaneous bleomycin models in mice with an inducible and fibroblast-specific abrogation of cAMP generation owing to deletion of the stimulatory G protein (Gs). Abolishing cAMP generation in fibroblasts after peak lung fibrosis was established led to a failure of the resolution with single-cell RNA seq demonstrating conspicuous differences in pathway enrichment and cellular cross-talk not only in fibroblasts, but also within macrophages and epithelial cells. Spontaneous resolution of skin fibrosis in a model of scleroderma similarly required cAMP production in dermal fibroblasts. We conclude that cAMP generation within fibroblasts after tissue fibrosis has been established is required for its spontaneous resolution in the lung and skin. Our findings provide new insights into factors governing the outcome of tissue fibrosis as well as a mechanistic basis that helps to explain the therapeutic efficacy and ultimate potential of newly available and emerging cAMP-elevating agents.
papers.titleZh: 組織纖維母細胞內源性 cAMP 生成是自發性纖維化消退所必需
papers.summaryZh: 本研究探討纖維母細胞內源性環狀腺苷單磷酸 cAMP 在纖維化消退中的體內作用。作者指出病理性肌纖維母細胞與持續性組織纖維化相關，而 cAMP 在體外可誘導肌纖維母細胞去分化並恢復其對凋亡的敏感性，但其內源性角色尚未被探討。研究利用小鼠單次劑量肺內與皮下bleomycin自發消退模型，並以誘導性且纖維母細胞特異性刪除刺激性 G 蛋白 Gs 的方式阻斷 cAMP 生成。結果顯示，在肺纖維化高峰後於纖維母細胞中消除 cAMP 生成會導致消退失敗，單細胞 RNA 定序顯示纖維母細胞、巨噬細胞與上皮細胞的路徑富集與細胞間交互作用均有顯著差異。皮膚硬皮症模型的自發性皮膚纖維化消退同樣需要真皮纖維母細胞的 cAMP 生成。作者據此認為纖維化建立後，纖維母細胞內的 cAMP 生成對肺與皮膚的自發性消退是必需的。

papers.title: KDM3B enforces a non-mutational ErbB signaling state that sustains cholangiocarcinoma
papers.abstract: More than 50% of cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) patients lack druggable mutations, showing broad non-mutational epigenetic perturbations, whose mechanistic insights and clinical benefit remain largely unexplored. Across multiple CCA patient cohorts, we identified prevalent significant upregulation of lysine demethylase (KDM) gene families, with KDM3B emerging as a critical epigenetic dependency for sustaining tumor fitness. KDM3B loss reduced colony formation, proliferation, and migration across intra- and extrahepatic CCA tumor models. Integrated multi-omics linked KDM3B to ErbB activation and downstream PI3K-AKT oncogenic signaling. Mechanistically, KDM3B is bound to the ERBB3 promoter, removing repressive H3K9me2 marks to transcriptionally activate ERBB3, augmenting ErbB receptor activity. Spatial and single cell transcriptomics from patient tumors revealed that high KDM3B-ERBB3 coupling reshapes the tumor niche via enhancing the epithelial-mesenchymal transition crosstalk with neighborhood cells to establish a pro-invasive microenvironment. Pharmacologic inhibition in vivo of the KDM3B downstream ERBB-Akt regulatory axis suppressed CCA xenograft tumor growth. These findings establish KDM3B as a non-mutational epigenetic activator of ErbB-driven signaling, reshaping the tumor ecosystem, and defining the KDM3B-ErbB axis as a vulnerability in CCA.
papers.titleZh: KDM3B 強制維持膽管癌的非突變性 ErbB 訊號狀態

papers.title: Age-dependent downregulation of endothelial lamin A/C impairs mechanotransduction and promotes cardiovascular disease
papers.abstract: Aims: Aging is a major risk factor for cardiovascular disease, but the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Here, we investigated age-associated changes in endothelial lamin A/C expression and the contribution of endothelial lamin A/C loss to cardiovascular dysfunction and disease. Methods and Results: Aging was associated with reduced endothelial lamin A/C expression in human coronary arteries and mouse aorta and heart. We generated an inducible endothelial-specific Lmna knockout mouse model on an atheroprone Ldlr-null background (LmnaKOiEC), which exhibited a 14.6% reduction in median survival. Vascular and cardiac phenotypes were evaluated using vascular reactivity assays, magnetic resonance imaging, blood pressure measurements, echocardiography, histology, nitric oxide assays, and biochemical analyses. LmnaKOiEC mice exhibited increased atherosclerotic burden, impaired endothelium-dependent vasodilation, vascular hyperpermeability, arterial stiffening, and hypertension. They also displayed increased cardiac mass, elevated NT-proBNP levels, incipient myocardial fibrosis, and signs of increased cardiac filling pressures despite preserved systolic function, resembling early stages of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). Cardiac proteomics revealed inflammatory, profibrotic, and metabolic remodeling, with enrichment of molecular signatures associated with human HFpEF. Mechanistically, aortic single-cell transcriptomics revealed endothelial activation and suppression of the flow-responsive KLF2-NOS3 pathway. Consistently, endothelial lamin A/C deficiency reduced aortic nitric oxide production ex vivo, while siRNA-mediated LMNA knockdown impaired shear stress-induced KLF2 and NOS3 expression in human aortic endothelial cells. Conclusion: These findings identify age-associated endothelial lamin A/C downregulation as a previously unrecognized contributor to cardiovascular aging and disease, and suggest preservation of endothelial nuclear mechanotransduction as a potential therapeutic strategy. Translational Relevance: Our findings identify age-associated endothelial lamin A/C downregulation as a previously unrecognized contributor to cardiovascular aging, linking impaired nuclear mechanotransduction to age-related endothelial dysfunction and cardiovascular pathologies, including atherosclerosis, hypertension, and cardiac alterations resembling early HFpEF. These results highlight endothelial lamin A/C and downstream flow-responsive KLF2-NOS3 signaling as potential targets for therapeutic strategies aimed at preserving endothelial function and mitigating age-related cardiovascular disease.
papers.titleZh: 內皮細胞中 lamin A/C 隨年齡下降會減損機械轉導並促進心血管疾病
papers.summaryZh: 本研究探討了年齡相關的內皮細胞 lamin A/C 表現量降低，對心血管功能障礙與疾病的影響。研究發現，人類冠狀動脈與小鼠主動脈和心臟中的內皮細胞 lamin A/C 會隨著老化而減少。利用誘導性內皮細胞專一性 Lmna 基因剔除小鼠模型，研究人員觀察到動脈硬化負擔增加、內皮依賴性血管舒張受損、血管高通透性、動脈僵硬以及高血壓等表型。此外，這些小鼠也展現出類似保留收縮分率心臟衰竭（HFpEF）早期階段的心臟病理特徵。機制上，單細胞轉錄體學顯示內皮細胞活化以及對流體切應力有反應的 KLF2-NOS3 路徑受到抑制。這些發現指出，年齡相關的內皮 lamin A/C 下調是心血管老化與疾病的新機制。

papers.title: Catch*ReSeq resolves rare splice isoforms and their host cell states at single-cell resolution
papers.abstract: Alternative splicing diversifies the transcriptome and shapes cell fate across development, tissue function, and disease. Single-cell RNA sequencing can link isoforms to cell states, but these methods often lack the throughput and coverage to accurately call splice variants. As a result, rare isoforms are often missed, especially in underrepresented cell types. Here, we present Catch*ReSeq, a targeted enrichment method that yields isoform-resolved readouts linked to host transcriptomes from standard single-cell libraries for the capture of rare isoforms. We found more oligo(dT)-primer cDNA originating from internal A-rich sequences than from terminal polyA tails (80-fold enrichment for simian immunodeficiency virus (SIV) and over 6-fold for host transcripts), fracturing cDNA and obscuring isoforms. Catch*ReSeq exploits this fracture to infer each molecule's isoform of origin. In SIV-infected macaque CD4+ T cells, Catch*ReSeq detected up to 13 times as many infected cells as standard 10X and resolved spliced viral isoforms that 10X missed entirely. Splice+ cells carried a translational host program independent of how much virus they transcribed, a distinction invisible to standard single-cell sequencing methods. From macaque and PWH on ART, Catch*ReSeq recovered 13-fold more virus-transcribing cells than 10X, including splice+ cells. We also demonstrated the generalizability of Catch*ReSeq across biological systems by applying it in combination with lineage barcoding to probe alternative splicing in clonally expanded CD4+ T cells, and separately in mouse liver regeneration. As Catch*ReSeq works with archived cDNA and can be redesigned for new targets after the fact, it allows rare isoform profiling on existing biobanked and clinical samples.
papers.titleZh: Catch*ReSeq 以單細胞解析度鑑別罕見剪接異構型及其宿主細胞狀態
papers.summaryZh: 本研究發表名為 Catch*ReSeq 的標靶富集方法，能夠從標準單細胞文庫中取得與宿主轉錄體相連結且具備異構型解析度的讀數，以捕捉罕見的剪接異構型。研究指出內部 A 豐富序列會導致 cDNA 斷裂並掩蓋異構型，而 Catch*ReSeq 利用此特徵來推斷每個分子的來源異構型。在感染猴免疫缺陷病毒（SIV）的獼猴 CD4+ T 細胞中，該方法偵測到的受感染細胞數量達到標準 10X 方法的 13 倍，並能解析被標準方法遺漏的病毒剪接異構型。此外，此技術亦成功應用於結合譜系條碼以探討源自源自源自（略）等其他生物系統，且適用於已建檔的 cDNA 與現有生物庫及臨床檢體。

papers.title: Identification of JMJD1C as a key mediator of fibroblast remodelling in human AF by single-nucleus multi-omics
papers.abstract: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most prevalent arrhythmia, accounting for up to 15% of arrhythmias in the elderly. Atrial enlargement associated with fibrotic and hypertrophic remodelling, termed atrial myopathy (AM), is considered a precursor to AF development. The mechanisms underlying the development of AM and its progression to AF remain incompletely resolved. To identify the unique and combined contributions of the major cellular mediators of AM and AF, we combine single-nucleus transcriptomics of human left and right atrial appendages (LAA and RAA) with paired RNA and chromatin-accessibility profiling of 20 LAA samples. We validate these findings through histological and functional studies in primary human cardiac fibroblasts (HCFs). Patients were stratified according to the presence of AF and AM (identified by left atrial volume dimensions; LAVI, Hi and Lo), generating Hi-AF, Hi-SR, Lo-AF and Lo-SR groups that separate AF-associated from structural-remodelling-associated alterations. Across 75,654 qualified nuclei, AF was associated with chamber-dependent shifts in cellular composition and gene expression, with extracellular matrix (ECM) and TGF-beta programmes prominent in LAA. Multiome analysis identified a stressed atrial cardiomyocyte (aCM4) state expressing natriuretic peptide A (NPPA) and natriuretic peptide B (NPPB), with altered cis-regulatory connectivity, and an inflammatory fibroblast (PTGDS+ FB) state characterised by IL-6 expression and matrix- and TGF-beta-associated programmes. Enhancer-driven network analysis identified GLIS3, TWIST2 and TBX20 as regulators of FB state transitions. The histone demethylase JMJD1C was enriched in PTGDS+ FB and induced by TGF-beta; its depletion attenuated alpha-smooth-muscle-actin (alpha-SMA) accumulation and reprogrammed TGF-beta-responsive transcription. Ligand-receptor analysis further predicted macrophage-to-FB TGF-beta signalling, showing the contribution of macrophages to the atrial inflammatory environment. These data define discrete aspects of rhythm- and structure-associated remodelling of human atrial tissue and identify a candidate macrophage-TGF-beta-JMJD1C-FB interaction for potential therapeutic development.

papers.title: Single-cell and spatial multi-omics mapping of human ovarian aging across young and menopausal transition
papers.abstract: Ovarian aging is an early feature of human aging with broad consequences for women's health, yet its cellular dynamics across the menopausal transition remain unclear. We integrated single-cell transcriptomic, chromatin accessibility and spatial transcriptomic profiles across young, menopausal-transition and postmenopausal human ovaries. Granulosa cells (GCs) exhibited the most pronounced age-associated transcriptional remodelling. The menopausal transition was characterized by reduced DNA-repair activity and elevated stress-response programs in GCs, alongside broader changes in hormone-response and steroid-metabolic programs during ovarian aging. Integrated regulatory analyses implicated HEYL, a GC-enriched transcription factor, with reduced accessibility at a putative regulatory element during aging. Genetic analyses associated HEYL and its predicted upstream regulators with age at natural menopause, while spatial mapping revealed enrichment of menopause-associated genetic signals in GC-rich regions. HEYL depletion increased senescence-associated phenotypes in human granulosa-like cells and primary mouse GCs, whereas overexpression attenuated oxidative-stress-induced senescence. Perturbation of its orthologue Hey produced consistent effects in Drosophila ovaries. Together, our atlas reveals stage-associated granulosa-cell remodeling and implicates HEYL in ovarian aging.
papers.titleZh: 單細胞與空間多體學描繪人類卵巢在年輕至停經轉換期的老化

papers.title: Midkine and the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: evidence from Mendelian randomization, multi-omics factor analysis, and single-cell transcriptomics
papers.abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains one of the most lethal malignancies, in part because its tumor microenvironment actively suppresses antitumor immunity. Midkine (MDK) is a secreted heparin-binding growth factor that is overexpressed in a majority of PDAC tumors, but whether it contributes causally to disease risk and through which cell types it acts have not been firmly established. We combined cis-eQTL Mendelian randomization (GTEx pancreas, n = 328 donors; FinnGen PDAC, 1,252 cases) with multi-omics factor analysis (MOFA) of TCGA-PAAD tumors (n = 149), single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA), cross-species single-cell RNA sequencing, and DepMap CRISPR dependency screening. Mendelian randomization identified MDK as the only gene passing false discovery rate correction for PDAC risk (inverse-variance-weighted odds ratio 1.51, 95% CI 1.19-1.91, p = 6.7 x 10??; FDR = 0.008), with concordant direction across five methods and five independent GWAS. MDK was overexpressed in tumors relative to adjacent normal tissue in an independent cohort (GSE62452, n = 130, p = 5 x 10??), and high expression was associated with shorter overall survival (10.2 versus 21.1 months, p = 0.023). In the MOFA decomposition, MDK localized to a factor characterized by tertiary lymphoid structure gene expression but negative correlation with dendritic cells and macrophages, a pattern consistent with immune exclusion. Single-cell analysis and published functional studies indicated that MDK is produced by cancer-associated fibroblasts and endothelial cells rather than by tumor epithelium, and DepMap data confirmed that MDK is not a cell-autonomous fitness gene. Collectively, these results support a model in which MDK acts through the stromal-immune compartment rather than through tumor cell-intrinsic mechanisms, and raise the possibility that MDK blockade could restore antitumor immunity in PDAC.
papers.titleZh: Midkine 與胰管腺癌免疫抑制性腫瘤微環境：孟德爾隨機化、多體學因子分析與單細胞轉錄體學的證據

papers.title: Learning gene co-regulation across cells with Multicellular Transformer
papers.abstract: Understanding how genes coordinate across cells is central to explaining tissue function and disease, yet most existing models still take a single cell as input and therefore emphasize cell-intrinsic regulation. We present the Multicellular Transformer (MCT), a foundation model built around a different assumption: cells function together within tissues, so the appropriate unit of input is not one cell in isolation but a set of cells from the same sample. By jointly modeling multiple cells, MCT learns context-aware gene embeddings that capture gene-gene interactions across the tissue environment. Trained on a large set of tissue samples (>4200) across more than 30 tissue types, MCT recovers ligand-receptor interactions, infers cross-cell signaling programs, and reveals spatial co-localization patterns directly from scRNA-seq data. Its contextual embeddings identify disease-specific rewiring of gene neighborhoods in systemic lupus erythematosus and COVID-19 and predict population-level perturbation effects in cancer without additional training. By linking gene-level regulation to tissue-scale organization, MCT provides a scalable framework for modeling multicellular biology and enables in silico discovery of therapeutic targets and tissue-specific dependencies.
papers.titleZh: 以 Multicellular Transformer 學習跨細胞的基因共調控

papers.title: Integrating Unsupervised Clustering with Transformer-Based Models for De Novo Cell Population Identification
papers.abstract: Single-cell transcriptome sequencing has been widely applied across the life sciences. It enables accurate and robust identification of cell types in heterogeneous biological tissues through unsupervised clustering, shallow learning, and deep learning. While deep learning does not outperform shallow learning in classification performance, it streamlines cell type identification by eliminating cumbersome preprocessing procedures. However, the availability of training datasets with comprehensive cell type annotations is always limited, so new datasets inevitably contain cell populations that are not pre-defined in the training data. To address this limitation, we integrated unsupervised clustering with transformer-based models to identify cell populations unrecognized by classical methods. Specifically, we developed the Nankai GeneRank Classifier by fine-tuning the pre-trained Geneformer-V1 model, and then clustered cells based on its softmax-normalized class probability matrix (SCPM). Applied to a public colorectal cancer dataset, the new method, named SCPM-based clustering, resolved cell populations that cannot be unambiguously identified by classical methods alone and led to the discovery of novel candidate markers of colorectal cancer stem cells, demonstrating its utility.
papers.titleZh: 整合非監督式分群與基於 Transformer 的模型以進行從頭細胞群體識別
papers.summaryZh: 本研究整合了非監督式分群與基於 Transformer 的模型，旨在識別經典方法未能辨識的細胞群體。研究團隊透過微調預訓練的 Geneformer-V1 模型開發出 Nankai GeneRank Classifier，並根據其 softmax 標準化類別機率矩陣（SCPM）對細胞進行分群。將此稱為 SCPM-based clustering 的新方法應用於公開的大腸直腸癌（colorectal cancer）資料集時，成功解析出無法單靠經典方法明確識別的細胞群體，並發現了大腸直腸癌幹細胞的新候選標記，展現了其應用價值。

papers.title: Evaluating the ability of spatial transcriptomics foundation models to learn multi-scale spatial variation
papers.abstract: Spatial gene expression results from the superposition of multiple sources of variation in gene expression across different spatial scales, including local microenvironment-associated variation and global spatial gradients. Spatial foundation models (SFMs) are large-scale machine learning models trained on cohorts of spatial transcriptomics (ST) data that, in principle, learn the different sources of spatial variation in gene expression. However, the embeddings learned by SFMs are difficult to interpret, and it remains unclear whether they fully capture such spatial variation. Here, we develop SAFFRON, a sparse autoencoder (SAE)-based framework for interpreting and evaluating SFMs. SAFFRON uses a Matryoshka SAE to decompose dense SFM embeddings into sparse, human-interpretable features and evaluates whether these features correlate with known sources of spatial variation. Using SAFFRON, we systematically benchmark the ability of several recent SFMs to identify local and global spatial variation in gene expression. We find that only two SFMs learn global spatial gradients more accurately than naive, non-foundation model baselines; further investigating one such SFM, SAFFRON reveals that these gradients are concentrated in a small subset of sparse, human-interpretable SAE features. On the other hand, no SFM learns local patterns (A{beta} plaque microenvironment-associated patterns) more accurately than such baselines. Our findings suggest that current SFMs do not systematically learn multi-scale spatial variation in gene expression. Code: SAFFRON is available at https://github.com/chitra-lab/SAFFRON.
papers.titleZh: 評估空間轉錄組學基礎模型學習多尺度空間變異的能力
papers.summaryZh: 空間基因表現源自不同空間尺度上多重變異的疊加，包含局部微環境相關變異與整體空間梯度。空間基礎模型 Spatial foundation models, SFMs 是在大規模空間轉錄組學資料集上訓練的大型機器學習模型，理論上可學習這些空間變異來源，但其嵌入難以解釋，是否完整捕捉空間變異尚不明確。作者開發 SAFFRON，一個基於稀疏自編碼器 Sparse autoencoder, SAE 的框架，用於解釋與評估 SFMs；SAFFRON 使用 Matryoshka SAE 將密集的 SFM 嵌入分解為稀疏且具人類可解釋的特徵，並評估這些特徵與已知空間變異來源的相關性。利用 SAFFRON 系統性基準測試數個近期 SFMs 識別局部與整體空間變異的能力，結果顯示僅有兩種 SFMs 在學習整體空間梯度上優於天真的非基礎模型基線，且進一步分析顯示這些梯度集中於少數稀疏可解釋的 SAE 特徵中。另一方面，沒有任何 SFM 能在局部模式，例如 Aβ 斑塊微環境相關模式 的學習上優於基線。研究指出目前的 SFMs 並未系統性地學習基因表現的多尺度空間變異。

papers.title: Spectrast: a multiscale spatial statistics toolkit for single-cell spatial transcriptomics
papers.abstract: Spatial transcriptomics resolves gene expression in physical space, but the spatial statistics typically used to quantify spatial organization scale poorly to imaging-based datasets with hundreds-of-thousands of cells and thousands of genes. We recast the standard spatial-autocorrelation statistics as convolutions on a rasterized representation of the gene expression matrix and evaluate them with the fast Fourier transform. Measuring spatial statistics across multiple length scales becomes tractable for every gene using this approach, which extends naturally to differential reorganization testing between two tissue conditions.

papers.title: MeXalign - A Segmentation Mask-Based Registration Pipeline for Multimodal Single-Cell Analysis
papers.abstract: Leveraging the power of multimodal imaging relies on accurate coregistration of yet fundamentally different modalities. Reliable cell-to-cell correspondence is especially challenging as consecutive tissue sections do not necessarily contain identical cells or cellular structures. Here we present MeXalign, a segmentation-mask-based coregistration pipeline designed to integrate multimodal images acquired sequentially from the same specimen at single-cell resolution. Single-cell segmentation masks provide a modality-independent representation of cellular morphology and spatial organization. MeXalign was tested based on the two platforms, laser ablation inductively coupled plasma time-of-flight mass spectrometry (LA-ICP-TOFMS) and immunofluorescence (IF) microscopy. As a prerequisite, each modality integrates membrane and/or nucleus labels for accurate segmentation. The added value of MeXalign was highlighted for imaging of cell models deposited on glass slides and tissue sections. The performance of coregistration was validated on cytospins, murine tumor and human skin samples. A dedicated scoring system was introduced allowing to assess the quality of image coregistration. The robustness towards under-segmentation and downstream image analysis was evaluated on LA-ICP-TOFMS with and without coregistration, investigating metal drug uptake, barcoding and cellular phenotyping. A showcase study on cancer cells exposed to nanoparticles proved the accuracy, as the nanoparticle distribution was preserved at a subcellular level when using MeXalign. While all examples show the overall improved quality of segmentation, other benefits of complementary labelings can be anticipated, especially for cellular features unique to one modality.

papers.title: Marker direction and donor structure alter genetic cell-stateprioritization in endometriosis: convergent evidence from single-cell chromatin
papers.abstract: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) identify regions of the genome linked to disease, but they do not tell us which cells are involved. Researchers often address that question by testing marker genes from single-cell atlases. We asked how much the answer changes when those markers are defined differently. Reconstructing a published endometriosis analysis, we found that selecting genes with large fold changes in either direction prioritized venous endothelium, whereas selecting up-regulated genes prioritized decidual stroma (the latter was not significant after within-family false-discovery correction). A calibrated benchmark, six-trait control panel, and donor-level checks showed why neither rule can be trusted on its own. In an independent RNA atlas, stromal programs were repeatedly prioritized, although closely related perivascular states remained plausible. We then examined an independent molecular layer: chromatin accessibility in 36,073 nuclei from 12 endometrial biopsies. The initially specified analysis found enrichment of endometriosis heritability in stromal accessible chromatin (z = 4.11, one-sided p = 2 x 10^-5). In a later, more stringent joint model with baselineLD v2.2, the stromal coefficient remained positive (z = 3.83, p = 6.47 x 10^-5) and exceeded the epithelial coefficient (z = 3.68, p = 1.18 x 10^-4). Both effects remained nominally significant when each biopsy was excluded in turn (12/12 analyses). The association was also seen for leiomyoma, and the endometriosis GWAS share participants. Together, these findings support a broad stromal regulatory context for part of inherited endometriosis risk, but do not establish a unique causal cell state or a lesion cell of origin.

papers.title: Spatial causal discovery reveals novel mechanisms of cellular senescence in human liver
papers.abstract: The complex network of mechanisms that surround cellular senescence, such as its precise causes and effects, are not entirely understood at present. Senescence occurs when a cell permanently ceases dividing, halts apoptosis, stops performing its normal functions, and begins secreting chemicals that can induce other cells in its environment to also become senescent. Senescent cells are present in both healthy and unhealthy tissue, but their abundance is positively correlated with disease and age. A better understanding of senescence could lead to healthier aging, improved recovery from chemotherapy, or increased lifespan. This study used novel machine learning algorithms - with guaranteed properties of correctness under broad assumptions - to investigate senescence in human liver tissue by analyzing Visium spatial transcriptomics data. This produced data-driven models of the causes and effects of senescence, both locally and from nearby tissue. This report includes an assessment of whether the data meet key requirements for causal analysis, the transcripts identified by causal analyses as causes and effects of senescence marker genes, and pathway analyses of those gene sets.

papers.title: Revealing the transcriptomic organization of extrasomatic interfaces using SCOUBI
papers.abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) generates substantial transcript signal outside segmented cell bodies, which is generally discarded by analysis tools. This is especially problematic for brain ST data, as neuronal mRNAs can be localized far from somata - in axons, dendrites, and synaptic compartments - and up to half of the transcripts in ST data may lie outside cell bodies. Here, we present SCOUBI, a computational framework that identifies axon-dendrite interfaces from extrasomatic RNA in ST data, revealing a hitherto overlooked layer of molecular function in neural tissues. It first partitions extrasomatic space into axon- and dendrite-enriched compartments based on known marker genes, using a neural network trained to maximize marker specificity and inter-compartment communication signals. It then defines interfaces as loci where predicted axonal and dendritic compartments converge and exhibit ligand-receptor colocalization. Applied to mouse brain, SCOUBI creates maps of axonal and dendritic compartments and their interfaces that align with known spatial patterns of neurite and synaptic distribution. It identifies transcriptomic differences between interfaces and the surrounding extrasomatic space, revealing region-specific signatures of neuronal signaling and synaptic plasticity. By comparing interface transcript enrichment with local somatic expression, SCOUBI identifies genes that preferentially localize at sites of intercellular communication rather than simply reflecting nearby cell bodies. SCOUBI reveals interface-associated transcripts beyond established synaptic genes, with molecular signatures reproducible across independent samples and imaging platforms. In summary, SCOUBI transforms a substantial and often-discarded aspect of ST data into an interpretable readout of subcellular organization and neural signaling.

papers.title: Paired multiomic profiling defines the healthy human synovium infrapatellar fat pad stromal continuum
papers.abstract: The synovium and infrapatellar fat pad (IPFP) are anatomically contiguous tissues implicated in osteoarthritis, yet their cellular and molecular organization in the healthy human knee remains poorly defined. We combined bulk RNA sequencing with paired single-nucleus transcriptomic and chromatin accessibility profiling to establish a quantitative multiomic reference of healthy human synovium and IPFP. Analysis of 54,716 nuclei from six cadaveric donors identified 23 synovial and 20 IPFP cell populations and indicated that the two tissues share one transcriptionally continuous, largely quiescent stromal compartment. Stromal populations shared core transcriptional programs but differed primarily in extracellular matrix output, with transcripts of inhibitory regulators predominating over those of their functional opponents. TIMP3 exceeded MMP14 in 42 of 43 single-nucleus populations across both tissues and by 13- to 39-fold in bulk tissue. Chromatin accessibility primarily distinguished stromal lineages and resolved transcriptionally defined subtypes, separating synovial lining from sublining fibroblasts and adipocytes from fibroblasts. Fibroblast and adipocyte populations occupied a common transcriptional trajectory accompanied by declining expression of organelle-turnover programs and little proliferation, with no dividing adipocytes and fewer than 0.05% of fibroblasts in the cell cycle. Despite this shared organization, the IPFP exhibited greater inferred intercellular signaling, attributable in part to BMP5, which was not detected in synovium. These findings describe healthy synovium and IPFP as regionally specialized parts of a transcriptionally continuous stromal compartment and provide a quantitative reference for identifying cellular and regulatory changes in joint disease.

papers.title: Dynamic multi-omics analysis of Adenovirus-induced rAAV-producing stable cell lines reveals the interplay between adenoviral infection and host cell metabolism
papers.abstract: Recombinant adeno-associated viruses (rAAV) are invaluable delivery vehicles for gene therapy. However, to make rAAV-based therapies more accessible, there is a need to increase rAAV titers. Here we analyze the phenotypic variation among 30 Adenovirus-induced stably-transfected human producer cell clones to identify metabolic signatures associated with high vs low rAAV production. Exometabolomic characterization revealed decreased amino acid consumption in higher producers. Analysis of RNA-Seq data in the context of a genome-scale metabolic model identified upregulated carnosine biosynthesis-associated pathways during the first 6 hours post infection with adenovirus, relative to uninfected growth. Meanwhile, late infection timepoints exhibited increased amino acid release and de novo biosynthesis of serine, glycine, and arginine. Moreover, high producers decreased expression of genes linked with cholesterol biosynthesis and increased HMG-CoA degradation via HMGCL. Furthermore, sphingosine and ceramide biosynthesis genes were altered in high-producers in directions previously reported to resist cell death and suppress immune signaling. Overall, these findings elucidate the metabolic modulation upon adenoviral infection in a helper virus-induced AAV production process using stably transfected human cell lines.

papers.title: SH2 Domain Protein E sustains perivascular fibroblasts to maintain arterial stability
papers.abstract: Developing arteries must withstand pulsatile blood flow while remaining sufficiently flexible to accommodate changing hemodynamic demands. Endothelial interactions with perivascular cells and the extracellular matrix (ECM) are essential for this balance, but the signaling mechanisms that coordinate them remain incompletely understood. We previously showed that SH2 domain protein E (She), an endothelial adaptor protein implicated in ABL signaling, is required to maintain the size and structural stability of the dorsal aorta (DA) in zebrafish embryos. she mutant embryos develop DA collapse and circulatory failure at 4 to 5 days post-fertilization, yet the underlying cause has not been identified. Here, we investigated the role of She in recruiting ECM-producing perivascular stromal cells to regulate the structural stability of the DA. She mutants had fewer collagen producing perivascular stromal cells between the DA and posterior cardinal vein. This correlated with smaller perivascular col1a1 and col5a1 expression domains, reduced col1a1 transcript and Collagen I pro-peptide levels, and increased DA distensibility. Single-cell RNA sequencing independently identified a reduced relative abundance of a perivascular fibroblast subpopulation. In contrast, DA-associated mural cell number, laminin immunoreactivity, and local col4a1 transcript levels were not detectably altered. Partial ablation of mural cells alleviated DA narrowing and circulatory failure, while the nitric oxide donor sodium nitroprusside provided partial rescue. These findings support a contribution of mural cell-dependent vascular tone to the collapse of the mechanically vulnerable DA. Mutants also exhibited cardiac chamber enlargement, increased atrial and bulbus arteriosus deformation, atrioventricular regurgitation, and increased Elastin B accumulation in the enlarged bulbus arteriosus. However, endocardial-specific She expression failed to rescue circulatory failure, supporting its requirement in the vascular endothelium. Together, these findings argue that She functions in the vascular endothelium to recruit and/or maintain perivascular stromal cells, which produce fibrillar collagens required for arterial stability. These results reveal a new mechanism by which signals from the vascular endothelium promote ECM support to maintain arterial vascular stability.

papers.title: High-resolution mapping of the MCT uncovers late blastomere commitment and DREAM/MuvB-mediated restriction of blastomere plasticity
papers.abstract: Blastomeres are thought to lose multipotency rather sharply during early embryonic development in C. elegans, but the precise timing and regulation of this transition remain incompletely characterised. Here, we present a refined cell-fate challenge assay enabling high-resolution mapping of the multipotency-to-commitment transition (MCT). By combining precise heat-shock timing, 2-cell embryo synchronisation and single nuclei quantification, our method can detect subtle differences in blastomere plasticity across genotypes and developmental stages. Using this approach, we find that the MCT is more gradual than previously appreciated as blastomeres remain competent to adopt the body-wall muscle fate until at least the late 16E stage. We further show that the DREAM/MuvB complex core component LIN-54 restricts blastomere multipotency as does the H3K9 methyltransferase MET-2. Together, our work provides a sensitive single-cell assay for assessing developmental plasticity, reveals an extended timeline for the MCT and suggests that LIN-54/DREAM and MET-2 cooperate to promote blastomere commitment.
papers.titleZh: 高解析度描繪 MCT 揭示後期細胞分裂球承諾與 DREAM/MuvB 限制可塑性
papers.summaryZh: 本研究針對 C. elegans 早期胚胎發育中細胞分裂球失去多能性的時程進行探討。作者建立一套精煉的細胞命運挑戰檢測法，結合精確熱休克時序、2細胞胚胎同步化與單核定量，以高解析度描繪多能性到承諾的轉換 MCT。結果顯示 MCT 比先前認為的更為漸進，細胞分裂球至少到晚期 16E 階段仍具備採用體壁肌肉命運的潛能。研究進一步指出 DREAM/MuvB 複合體核心成分 LIN-54 與 H3K9 甲基轉移酶 MET-2 皆能限制細胞分裂球的多能性。整體工作提供評估發育可塑性的敏感單細胞檢測，並暗示 LIN-54/DREAM 與 MET-2 可能共同促進細胞分裂球承諾。

papers.title: Improving molecular property prediction with score-based diffusion models
papers.abstract: This work introduces a diffusion-based approach for small molecule prediction across a range of structure-activity and ADME tasks. It demonstrates strong predictive calibration and support for ensemble-driven uncertainty ranking.
papers.titleZh: 以分數型擴散模型提升分子性質預測
papers.summaryZh: 本研究提出一種以擴散為基礎的方法，用於小分子在多項結構活性與 ADME 任務中的性質預測。研究顯示該方法具有良好的預測校準性，並支援以集成驅動的不確定性排序。這些結果顯示擴散模型在分子性質預測任務中具潛力。

papers.title: Leveraging sequence purification for accurate prediction of multiple conformational states with AlphaFold2
papers.abstract: Proteins often adopt distinct conformations to carry out their functions. Here, the authors introduce AF-ClaSeq, a method that improves multistate structure prediction by clarifying evolutionary signals.

Brønsted/Lewis acid-catalyzed divergent cascade cyclization of alkoxyallene for the total synthesis of eburnane and aspidofractinine alkaloids
paper.abstract: Eburnane and aspidofractinine alkaloids are biogenetically related yet structurally distinct polycyclic monoterpenoids, whose syntheses have traditionally proceeded separately. Here, the authors report a divergent cascade from a common alkoxyallene precursor, enabling access to both scaffolds through acid controlled tandem pathways and total syntheses of representative alkaloids.

paper.title: Knowledge-guided machine learning deciphers spatiotemporal dynamics in chemical reactor systems
paper.abstract: A physics-informed neural network embeds coking and heat transfer knowledge via an output integration layer and region-weighted loss to predict reactor spatiotemporal fields; it matches conventional simulation results, improves peak wall temperature accuracy, and runs about five orders of magnitude faster than conventional simulations.

paper.title: Structurally guided wavefront neural encoder for broad-range generalizable 3D holography
paper.abstract: A single AI hologram generator works across distances and color without retraining, by learning how light scales — a step towards versatile, adaptive 3D holographic displays.
